phase: Phase 9 — Independent Dataset Audit and Baseline Eligibility
scope_boundary: Qualified solely for exploratory baseline ML experiments. Model promotion, production deployment, and operational inference remain BLOCKED.

artifact_integrity.evidence: 60/60 raw PCAPs readable with outer ESP/NAT-T frames; 60/60 packet CSVs verified; 60/60 session records verified; all SHA-256 hashes match.

ground_truth_integrity.evidence: 60/60 experiments verified with 100% endpoint agreement (ICMP reply counters, TCP payload hashes, HTTP 200 status codes with response body SHA-256 digests).

label_integrity.evidence: 3 canonical target classes defined in vista-target-label-schema-v1.json; HTTP GET and POST maintained as metadata subtypes; no label-bearing tokens in identifiers or filenames.

feature_integrity.evidence: 18/18 flow features in vista-flow-v1.json reproduce exactly (60/60 matches); extractor operates strictly on outer IPv4 ESP metadata without inner payload inspection.

leakage_controls.evidence: Zero session, IKE_SA identity, or SPI overlap across splits; zero exact duplicate feature vectors; zero near-duplicate vectors within 1e-6 relative tolerance.

class_coverage.evidence: All 3 target classes are represented in train (18 HTTP, 9 ICMP, 9 TCP), validation (6 HTTP, 3 ICMP, 3 TCP), and test (6 HTTP, 3 ICMP, 3 TCP) splits.

split_validity.evidence: Deterministic nested GroupShuffleSplit (seed 42) partitions strictly by independent session/IKE_SA lifecycle identity (9/3/3 sessions; 36/12/12 observations).

independent_campaign_validation.evidence: Dataset is drawn from a single 15-session campaign (76adc766-ef41-45f5-b677-1d950c7ff052) on one direct PC1-PC2 testbed. Cross-campaign, multi-day, or multi-host validation has not been performed.

baseline_eligibility.evidence: All 7 prerequisite integrity and leakage gates pass. Dataset is authorized solely for an explicitly scoped exploratory baseline experiment specification; NOT authorized for production promotion or operational deployment.
